thread:
jon: Heads-up: scheduled deploy tonight 23:30 UTC for ranking-v3 and session-store fixes. We'll do a staggered FF enable for ranking-v3 with regional cohorts to limit blast radius.

rachel: What are the cohorts and time windows? Any DB touches?

jon: No DB schema changes. Plan is us-west-2 3% -> 20% -> 100%, then eu-west-1 3% -> 20% -> 100%. Each step has a 10m soak and smoke harness. We'll pin ranking service to tag ranking:v3-beta4 during the canary phases.

diego: Rollback gates: immediate rollback if 5xx rate >0.3% sustained for 2m OR p99 latency regresses by >250ms vs baseline for 3 consecutive windows. Also abort if session-store error-rate >0.2%.

jon: Commands for ops are below, keep them handy.

jon: ```
# set cohort for us-west-2 to 3%
/deploy-bot ff set --flag ranking-v3 --region us-west-2 --percent 3
# bump to 20%
/deploy-bot ff set --flag ranking-v3 --region us-west-2 --percent 20
# full enable in us-west-2
/deploy-bot ff set --flag ranking-v3 --region us-west-2 --percent 100
# emergency disable everywhere
/deploy-bot ff unset --flag ranking-v3 --all
```

ops-bot: [INFO] scheduled pipeline dp-2026-477 for 23:30 UTC. Artifact pins: ranking=ranking:v3-beta4, session=session:2026-03-05-fix1.

jon: Good call. Add a smoke test after each step: 50 queries with golden responses check top-5 stability and idempotent session continuity test. Fail conditions mark the step unhealthy and stop the rollout.

rachel: I'll run smoke suite and post an aggregated pass/fail. If any failures, I'll mark the thread and hit the ff unset command.
